verdict.rationale: The evidence shows MoQ Relay as a generic low-latency publish/subscribe media relay, with tokens that can publish and subscribe. Nothing documents a server-side agent joining a session, receiving live audio, or publishing speech back. Generic pub/sub tokens are a developer building block from which such an agent could be built, not the agent-participant capability itself, so the axis applies but is unsupported.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, a server-side agent joins a session as a participant that receives live audio and publishes speech back in realtime
